import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'plugin/hooks')

print('10b', sg.shell_write_targets('python -c 1 <<< \"x\"\ngit rm -q CLAUDE.md'))

# item 11: brace expansion + git pathspec magic
print('11a', sg.shell_write_targets('git rm -q {CLAUDE,README}.md'))
print('11b', sg.shell_write_targets(\"git rm -q ':(icase)claude.md'\"))

# item 12

# item 13
print('13a', sg.shell_write_targets('git diff --output=CLAUDE.md'))
print('13b', sg.shell_write_targets('git checkout main CLAUDE.md'))
print('13c', sg.shell_write_targets('git config --file sdlc.yaml a.b c'))
print('13d', sg.shell_write_targets('python -m json.tool x.json sdlc.yaml'))
print('13e', sg.shell_write_targets('python -m pytest --basetemp=.claude'))
print('13f', sg.shell_write_targets('gh release download 1 -O CLAUDE.md'))
print('13g-negative', sg.shell_write_targets('git diff --stat --patch --output=changes/0002/evidence/diff-c.patch'))

# item 14 is resolve-level, test via decide
# item 15
print('15a', sg.shell_write_targets('git commit -m \"deny open(\\'CLAUDE.md\\',\\'w\\') via Bash\"'))
print('15b (comment)', sg.shell_write_targets('git status # then > CLAUDE.md'))

# item 16
print('16', sg.shell_write_targets('git fetch origin 2>\$null', powershell=True))
"
